name: Skimo threshold 4x8
description: Four hard climbs at the highest vertical rate the W1 allows for this length: raises the pace you can sustain on the climb.

ramp.name: Warm-up
ramp.notes: Easy and smooth. Nose breathing, shoulders loose.

steps.name: Threshold climb
steps.notes: RPE 7-8: comfortably hard, only a few words at a time.

steps.name: Recovery
steps.notes: Walk easy; let the heart rate come down.

ramp.name: Cooldown
ramp.notes: Let the breathing settle; sip water.
